decision.reason: Two printed coordinates have invalid DMS minutes; the January richness narrative (24) conflicts with Table 3 (23 rows with counts); Butis remains genus-only; Chelon/Planiliza status conflicts; Yarica halasoma lacks a species-level match; and no qualified publication review has been recorded.

ifReconsidered: Obtain authoritative correction for Villareal and Nangka coordinates, including station identity and datum; do not normalize minutes or geocode locality names.
Clarify the January 24-versus-23 richness discrepancy or retain it visibly unresolved.
Preserve source names and obtain qualified fish-taxonomy review for held labels and pending machine matches.
Retain the 2018-2019 date, study waterbody and reach scope; do not imply current presence or whole-river range.
Confirm noncommercial reuse terms and obtain qualified review and separate publication approval before any public derivative.
prohibitions: Do not turn historical catch counts into population abundance, catchability, diet, bait, safety or current legal advice.
Do not publish an accepted species label or map point for an invalid coordinate.
Do not substitute administrative or watershed geometry for sampled station locations.
nextAction: Continue the inland-water source sweep for Negros and Siquijor in parallel; revisit Bayawan only if an authoritative coordinate/table correction or qualified taxonomic review is available.
